note: The image briefs of a service business (site.json trade "service", lib/trade.mjs; owner 2026-11-06: site11's motel management pages were given models, sewing floors and cutting tables from the clothing briefs). Its photos are of the business's own work (photos "scenes": no product, model or shot list), each one of the owner's online-service class (photoClasses; owner 2026-11-17, via Site Factory: no more generic scenes on a service site): a de-identified report, a working screen or a delivered file, every client name, figure and logo unreadable, mostly on paper so the site stays within photo-subjects.json's screens share; a photo planned with nothing of the kind (a place, a building, people posing) is a generic scene the text check holds before it is made (check-photo-text.mjs). Photos made before 2026-11-17 stay while they fit their pages (no batch remake). The class subsumes the evidenceSubjects of 0a455cd (site12 claude-seo audit 2026-11-17, I-1: hotel facades, rooms, bars and terraces on the remote revenue-management pages). planFromCopy: what each page section's photo shows is planned from the page's copy (plan-photo-briefs.mjs, config/agent-steps/photo-briefs.md); the subjects below are only for photos no section describes (the heroes and the site's shared photos), written for any service: a site names its own (site.json imageSubjects, by class) for its trade's work, of which only those of the online-service class are planned (a class left with none takes these; image-plan.mjs classSubjects). {category} is the line (site.json line). siteKind names what the site is (site.json siteKind over this one). How the photos look still comes from the reference site alone (analyze:image-style). photoToShoot is what the owner's sheet asks to be shot for each class (handoff.mjs).
photoScope: Its photos are new photographs made for it of what its work delivers: de-identified reports, the working screens of the job and the files it hands over to clients.
scopeRule: Each photo shows a concrete piece of this business's own work as its subject: a de-identified report or summary, a marked-up worksheet, a handover pack, a plan or calendar of agreed changes, or the working screen of the job, every client name, figure and logo blurred or unreadable; most of them on paper, at most one in five a screen. A person appears only as hands at work or at the edge of the frame. Never a generic scene of a place, a building, a room or people posing, and nothing from another trade.
photoClassesNote: Every photo of a service business is of the online-service class (线上服务类, lib/photo-class.mjs; owner 2026-11-17): what it shows names one of serviceWords (a report, a screen, a delivered file). One that names none is a generic scene: never planned, and held by the text check if a section's brief asks for one.

prompts.productionSceneReplaced: a bright, clean place where this business works
prompts.productOnlySetting: Setting: {backdrop}, nothing else in the frame.
prompts.constraints: no text, no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks; no readable words on signs, screens, papers or uniforms; no certificates
prompts.reviewCriteria: Report: (1) lookAlike: groups of photos so similar in setting, composition and pose that a visitor would see them as the same shot; (2) samePerson: groups of photos showing the same person; (3) wrongColour: always empty (no colour is planned); (4) factoryScene: photos staged in a factory, sewing room, clothing workshop or warehouse, or anywhere else this business does not work; (5) weakSubject: photos that do not do their job: what the photo is planned to show is small, hidden or absent, or most of the frame is an empty room, hall, floor or wall (a portrait does its job when it shows one person's face and shoulders clearly).
prompts.portrait: Show one real-looking adult whose age, look and styling fit the name, role and country given; natural expression, looking at the camera.
prompts.realism: Photorealistic: a real photograph someone could have taken in the moment on a real camera, not a render, an illustration or an advertisement. The light comes from the place itself and falls the same way on the subject and the background; natural depth of field, slight film grain, nothing oversharpened.
prompts.realismPerson: The people look like real people, not retouched models: skin with natural texture and unevenness, no shine on the face; hair with loose strands; relaxed, unposed expressions; natural hands and proportions. No airbrushing or glamour retouching.
prompts.realismPlace: The place is real and in use: a little wear on its surfaces, things left where they are; no studio or cinematic lighting.
prompts.worker: People: the business's staff or its clients, adults of mixed ages and backgrounds in everyday work clothes, busy with what they are doing and not posing for the camera; nobody looks into the lens.
